items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: I was playing with Peter Brookhatt just a few or so.

ctx.x: That's pretty much, you know, we'll get a good- Well, when were- Where were you playing when the World War II broke out? 43? No, 43.
I was playing with Peter Brookhatt just a few or so.
But this is before then? Before then? Mm-hmm. I mean, this Rene Band, that was before you started with Brookhatt.
